LANGUAGE.TITLE: Language
LANGUAGE.DESCRIPTION: Select your preferred language. Automatic detection uses your browser language or timezone.

STORAGE.TITLE: Storage
STORAGE.DESCRIPTION: Your data is currently stored in {{provider}}. To change the storage location, visit the Storage page. If you want to transfer your data, export it first, then switch storage and import it back.

PWA.TITLE: App
PWA.DESCRIPTION: Sky Planner can be installed as a PWA (Progressive Web App) on supported browsers, making it easier to access than a bookmark.

DAILY_CANDLES.TITLE: Daily candles
DAILY_CANDLES.DESCRIPTION: Enter a number to add regular candles to your Currency page when you complete your (season) daily quests on the Dashboard or Daily tracker. Set to 0 to disable.
DAILY_CANDLES.LABEL: Candles per daily check-in

SPIRIT_TREES.TITLE: Spirit trees
SPIRIT_TREES.CONNECTED_ON: All items leading up to the one you unlock will also be unlocked. Likewise, locking an item will lock the ones beyond it.
SPIRIT_TREES.CONNECTED_OFF: When you unlock an item only that item will be unlocked. You can choose to also unlock all preceding items.

ITEMS.TITLE: Items
ITEMS.DESCRIPTION: The Items page shows item details in a panel beside the list. Clicking an item shows it there instead of opening the item page. Only available on screens at least 1280 pixels wide.
ITEMS.BUTTON_SIDE_PANEL: Show item details in a side panel

DATE.TITLE: Date
DATE.DESCRIPTION: Change the date format. Today is {{date}}.

TIME.TITLE: Time
TIME.DESCRIPTION: Change the time format. It's now {{time}}.

THEME.TITLE: Theme
THEME.ADVANCED_DESC: Tweaks apply on top of the selected theme. Sliders you haven't moved follow the theme.

NAV.TITLE: Navigation
NAV.WIKI_NEW_TAB: Open Wiki links in a new tab

SHORTCUTS.TITLE: Shortcuts
SHORTCUTS.DESCRIPTION: Show quick keyboard shortcuts for fast navigation and search.
